title: Executable QG manifest + artifact validator: required cells, scale ladder, terminal-status persistence
description:
Turn docs/contracts/quill-perf-gates.toml from prose hints into the executable source of truth.

- Versioned typed manifest enumerates every gate/cell, required versus diagnostic lanes, operation scope/version, fixtures/scales/query sets, engine implementations, thread/heap/positions/durability/cache topology, minimum samples/power, platform capability, absolute/relative metrics, A/A validity, safety and aspirational thresholds, evidence age and scale ladder.
- Harness derives cells from the manifest and emits one terminal artifact per attempted cell: MeasuredProvisional, InvalidNull/NoDecision, Quarantine, Block, Allow, Fatal, or UnsupportedBlocker with retry predicate. Severity precedence is deterministic. Only Allow from decision scale supports a claim.
- Validator detects missing/extra/duplicate cells, fake/shared engine denominator, scope/config mismatch, stale evidence, wrong executable/corpus/query hash, absent raw/absolute/null fields, invalid platform zeros and decision from failed null. History records every terminal status; an inactive gate can still be measured.
- Aggregate gate output separates completeness, validity, safety-envelope decision and aspirational target. One diagnostic failure cannot quarantine unrelated required cells; one fatal required-cell failure cannot be hidden by passing diagnostics.
- Generate human run plan/commands and tables from the manifest, preventing docs/harness drift.

Tests: manifest golden/round-trip; all ten gate expansions and expected cell counts; missing/duplicate/shared-engine/scope/hash/status-precedence cases; provisional/invalid history persistence; required-vs-diagnostic aggregation; platform blocker; stale artifact; human plan reconciliation. CI runs validator before and after every matrix slice.
acceptance_criteria: The versioned manifest expands deterministically into the complete normative QG-1 through QG-10 cell set, with required versus diagnostic classification, exact operation scope, scale ladder, fixture and query identities, engine implementation, thread, heap, durability, positions, cache and platform parameters, sample requirements, estimands and thresholds. The harness derives its run plan solely from the manifest and persists one terminal artifact for every attempted cell, including timeout, crash, invalid null, unsupported and provisional results. The validator rejects missing, extra, duplicate or shared-denominator cells; stale or mismatched executable, source, corpus, query, profile or platform identity; missing raw or absolute arms; invalid platform zeros; and any decision derived from a failed null. Golden expansion, round-trip, status precedence, required-versus-diagnostic isolation, stale/tamper cases, generated human command/table reconciliation and CI pre/post-slice validation pass. This foundation does not wait for live campaign closure.

title: quill-e8.4: Scaling-curve studies (Apple Silicon P/E + high-core x86)
description: The QG-8 contention-honesty study (plan §14, thesis §0.4): indexing throughput vs thread count {1,2,4,8,16,(32 where available)} on (a) Apple Silicon — P/E core asymmetry: verify work-stealing degrades gracefully when E-cores join (no cliff; document the P-only vs P+E curve), and (b) high-core x86 — verify the share-nothing claim: no shared-mutable contention means near-linear scaling through sealing; profile any plateau (allocator? page faults? memory bandwidth?) and attribute it (a bandwidth plateau is HONEST — document the ceiling; a lock plateau is a BUG). Tantivy's curve measured alongside (its writer-thread model + merge funnel is the comparison story). Output: scaling curves committed as artifacts + a summary in the evidence bundle; any discovered contention spawns lever beads under e8.5.
acceptance_criteria: On at least one supported Apple Silicon host and one isolated high-core x86 host, run Quill and pinned Tantivy at thread counts 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 and 32 where available under identical corpus, writer, heap, durability, storage and positions settings. Persist both-engine absolute docs/s and MB/s, CPU and wall time, peak RSS using a validated OS-specific probe, allocation rate, page-fault and memory-bandwidth evidence, raw samples, null controls, exact schedule and executable/source/corpus/worker hashes. Apple evidence distinguishes P-only from P-plus-E behavior; x86 evidence attributes every plateau to allocator, locks, faults or bandwidth. Aggregation and platform-probe golden tests reject unsupported-as-zero, inconsistent curve summaries and missing thread points. Bounded structured logs and immutable artifacts are retained. Every actionable contention source creates a one-lever child; no external allocator dependency is introduced.
notes: FRESH-EYES AMENDMENT: peak-RSS measurement is platform-specific — /proc/self/status is Linux-only; on Apple Silicon/macOS use mach task_info (or /usr/bin/time -l) for peak footprint. The harness must abstract the RSS probe per-OS or the Apple lane silently reports zeros. DUEL ADDITION (2026-07-16): the scaling study MUST attribute any multicore plateau to allocator behavior explicitly (global-allocator contention was Gemini's blind-spot concern; its proposed mimalloc/jemalloc fix VIOLATES the closed dependency universe, but the underlying question is legitimate): profile allocation rate on the ingest path at 1/8/16 threads; if the allocator is the plateau, the in-house remedy is deeper bump-arena coverage (e1.3 arenas already exist — widen what they cover), never a new allocator dep.

Preserve every existing curve as MeasuredProvisional with exact machine, topology, allocator, corpus, executable and A/A evidence; exploratory graphs cannot close QG-8. Machine eligibility is derived only from a hashed validated OS topology receipt, never hardcoded false, hostname, CI label or operator claim. Initial x86 admission requires AMD family 25 or newer, at least 16 physical cores, trustworthy physical/logical/SMT counts, requested threads no greater than logical CPUs, and enforceable thread/affinity budgets. Required cells are 1,2,4,8,16; 32 is required only when validated topology can run it, otherwise it is explicitly typed unavailable and cannot erase the lower-cell decision. Decision runs compare Quill and Tantivy with independent process/worker repetitions and record absolute docs/s, MB/s, stage times, peak RSS, allocation rate, bandwidth/page-fault/lock profiles, paired effects and nulls.

Apple P-only versus P+E remains typed NoDecision/UnsupportedBlocker until a defensible receipt proves P/E topology, scheduler placement and affinity enforcement; diagnostic rows may be retained but never enter QG-8 estimators. No platform path emits invented zeros. Immutable source/ELF/corpus/machine receipts, raw samples and A/A laws bind every admitted cell.
acceptance_criteria:
For every admitted x86 topology, required 1/2/4/8/16 thread cells appear exactly once for both engines; 32 appears only when logical/physical topology and enforced budgets support it, otherwise a typed per-cell omission is persisted. Eligibility is reconstructed from the exact validated OS receipt and rejects spoofed/malformed/missing topology, AMD family below 25, fewer than 16 physical cores, SMT mistaken for physical cores, requested threads above logical CPUs, inconsistent CPU masks, or unenforced affinity. Each admitted cell has absolute docs/s and MB/s, stage time, peak RSS, allocation/bandwidth/fault/lock attribution, raw independent process samples, paired effects, valid null controls and immutable machine/source/corpus/ELF provenance. Existing exploratory curves remain provisional.

Apple diagnostic execution is preserved, but absent P/E scheduler/affinity proof always yields typed NoDecision and its rows cannot enter claim estimates, tables labeled decision-grade, or ratchets. Tests cover the 16-core boundary, optional 32-cell behavior, malformed/spoofed receipts, SMT confusion, requested>logical, CPU-mask drift, Apple diagnostic isolation, pseudoreplication avoidance, provisional-versus-decision status and authoritative JSON regeneration of all plots/tables. Every material plateau/regression has measured attribution or a linked gauntlet investigation.

title: Active Quill Rust-port gauntlet: profile-first optimization rounds for every credible Tantivy loss
description:
TRIGGER: any statistically credible Quill regression on the workload actually executed creates one lane immediately. Diagnostic or noisy evidence can trigger measurement repair, profiling, and hypothesis design; decision-valid evidence is required only to KEEP, ship, activate a gate, or make a public claim.

GAUNTLET LOOP PER LOSING LANE:
1. Freeze exact paired corpus/query/config/executable/worker and correctness oracle. Reproduce with both-arm absolutes and same-invocation A/A; record deficiencies instead of suppressing useful diagnostics.
2. Profile the real timed path before editing: CPU, allocation, cache/page faults, I/O, locks, and durability as relevant. Name a concrete hot frame at least 0.1 percent self-time or measured bottleneck and record immutable baseline artifacts.
3. Rank hypotheses from profiles, Quill architecture, Tantivy behavior, negative evidence, measured ceilings, and candidate families. Reject already-mined ideas unless their retry predicate is satisfied. State expected recoverable fraction of the observed gap.
4. One isomorphic lever per child Bead and commit. Preserve public behavior, results, scores, metadata, errors, durability, cancellation, memory bounds, and unsafe-forbidden policy. Add focused unit, property, metamorphic, differential, and no-mock E2E regression tests appropriate to the lever.
5. Measure old Quill, new Quill, genuine Tantivy incumbent, and A/A in one admissible window with raw absolutes, distributions, CI, executable identity, and equal operation accounting. KEEP only when the causal old/new improvement clears noise, parity passes at the same SHA, and the incumbent comparison shows the user-visible effect without material regressions. Otherwise restore source non-destructively and land a precise negative-evidence row and retry predicate.
6. Re-profile after each keep and update the hypothesis frontier. Continue until the lane meets its target, measured ceilings prove the target infeasible, or two consecutive clean profile/discovery passes leave no unresolved high-impact hypothesis. There is no minimum round count. After three rejects in one candidate family, switch veins. Surface architecture or target decisions as soon as evidence triggers them.
7. Every keep/reject has separate commit/evidence, exact commands, worker, corpus/query/ELF hashes, before/after profiles, memory/durability impacts, and retained raw artifacts. Never bundle levers or quote cross-worker ratios as proof.

SEEDED FAMILIES retain entry criteria: batched term-dict AMAC, cold FST dictionaries, Elias-Fano long postings, cross-segment WAND threshold, sealed-dict MPH, NUMA placement, BM25 memo table, page-fault pipelining, arena coverage, grouped MaxScore. These are hypotheses, never authorization without profiles.

FINAL: rerun full conformance, safety envelope, and affected QG matrix; update ledgers and public docs with current measured claims only.
design: TRIGGER ENFORCEMENT: a decision-valid QG or bd-3beo safety loss with valid null where meaningful, both-arm absolutes, immutable artifact and exact scope activates one P0 optimization child. Invalid/noisy evidence repairs measurement and cannot admit a production edit. A very large provisional loss may create a PRE-ADMISSION profile/reproduction child such as .5.4; that work may profile and improve the harness but does not count as a gauntlet round until honest reproduction. Every admitted lever remains one change/commit with conformance, A/A+A/B, profile closure and keep/reject evidence. At terminal reconciliation this umbrella closes Completed with all triggered losses resolved or NotTriggered only if no valid loss existed.
acceptance_criteria: A credible measured loss creates a visible lane and immediate profile/measurement work; invalid evidence cannot support a production KEEP or public claim. Every production lever has an immutable baseline, attributed profile, one hypothesis and one change, focused and total conformance, same-window old-Quill/new-Quill causality, genuine Tantivy incumbent, randomized A/A, both-engine absolutes, raw samples, memory/durability accounting, keep-or-reject disposition, and retry predicate. No bundled speculative changes count. A lane closes only after meeting its predeclared target, or after evidence-triggered renegotiation, or after measured ceilings plus two clean discovery passes establish no admissible high-impact lever. Final full conformance, safety, and affected-QG reruns pass. Diagnostic measurements and locally ready machine classes are never blocked by unrelated hardware or lanes.
notes: DUEL ADDITIONS (2026-07-16, DUELING_WIZARDS_REPORT.md): two more seeded levers with entry criteria: (7) STEELMANNED 2D BM25 memoization table (Gemini idea, Fable cross-score 480, steelman best-version 680 — see WIZARD_STEELMAN_CC.md): freq-capped norm-major layout [tf 1..31 x fieldnorm 256] f32 = 32KiB/field, exact-computation fallback for tf>=32, same table supplies BMW bounds; PRECONDITION: the w*(tf/(tf+K)) association is the contract (already pinned by quill_contract.rs conventions, c5cd8b51); entry criteria: e4.3's per-snapshot 1D tf-cache (the tantivy-mirror already planned) shows scoring >=0.1% self-time AND the 2D variant beats it in a paired A/B at equal rank-parity. (8) madvise(WillNeed) page-fault pipelining after Grimoire probes (Gemini idea, score 580; API verified in pinned memmap2 0.9): entry criteria: cold-query p99 profile shows major page faults dominating AND a cold-cache detection heuristic exists (without gating, warm-path syscall overhead is a net regression — Gemini conceded); measure cold and warm separately, never blend.

title: Argus: deferred grouped MaxScore for nested pure-term unions
description: One-lever follow-up to E4.4's rejected eager nested topology. Introduce deferred group scoring so nested/default multi-field pure-term unions do not eagerly score each inner 4096-doc window before the root can prune. Eligibility must fail closed for unsupported groups. Acceptance: exact external document id, global docid, and f32 score-bit parity versus exhaustive for k={1,10,100,1000} across default multi-field/nested, randomized, mixed sealed+Delta, tombstone, and offset fixtures; setup-inclusive paired 100k/1M release A/B must beat both the E4.4 nested comparator and same-binary null floor. Record keep/reject evidence in the performance ledgers.
design: PLAN AUDIT 2026-07-26: this is an ordinary Argus frontier/performance follow-up based on code shape and prior local evidence, not a child triggered by a decision-valid Quill-versus-Tantivy QG loss. It does not count toward the conditional Rust-port gauntlet or its round count unless a future exact gate/cell/artifact is linked first. Correctness prerequisite bd-bt2t remains distinct from performance evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility fails closed for every unsupported group shape. Exact external document ID, global docid and f32 score-bit parity versus exhaustive scoring pass for k 1, 10, 100 and 1000 across default multi-field nested queries, randomized ASTs, mixed sealed plus Delta segments, tombstones and offset fixtures. Instrumentation proves deferred groups are evaluated only when root bounds require them. Setup-inclusive same-binary randomized A/A plus A/B runs at 100K and 1M beat both the E4.4 nested comparator and the null/noise floor without material ingest, open, RSS or correctness regression. Keep or reject evidence, raw samples, commands and provenance are committed to the ledgers. comments.author: cc
comments.text:
Claimed (cc/GentleSwan). Pivoted here after ledgering the fan-out ORCHESTRATION vein exhausted (bd-quill-e4-argus-3ycz.9: expansion-memo REJECT -1.3%, shared-cutoff DEFER, finish-skip WASH). Argus PRUNING is the fresh high-EV vein.

PREMISE CONFIRMED (code, not guess): index.rs query_has_prunable_root_union gates MaxScore/BMW on Union{children in 2..=MAX_SCORE_MAX_CLAUSES | BMW_MIN_CLAUSES.., direct_terms: TRUE}. A NESTED union (Boolean-of-multi-field-Terms = the common 'foo bar' over title+content default query) lowers to Union{direct_terms: FALSE} because each child multi-field Term is itself a Union not a Term (prunable_scorer_shape: 'direct_terms &= shape==Term'). direct_terms:false -> fails the gate -> pre-E4.4 POSTINGS-only EXHAUSTIVE path, ZERO pruning. So the most common multi-word/multi-field shape currently scores every 4096-doc window with no root cutoff. High EV.

DESIGN (deferred grouped MaxScore; E4.4 rejected the EAGER variant that scored each inner group window before the root could prune):
- Add a DEFERRED grouped scorer for Union{direct_terms:false} whose children are per-group multi-field-term unions. Each group exposes a whole-term MaxScore ceiling (sum of child term upper bounds) WITHOUT eagerly materializing/scoring its inner 4096-window.
- Root MaxScore orders groups by ceiling, advances essential groups, and only opens/scores a non-essential group's window when the running k-th cutoff makes it competitive (WAND-style on GROUP ceilings). Reuses the existing SealedBlockMax/whole-term ceiling (argus.rs supports_block_max=false path = MaxScore-only, sufficient here).
- Eligibility FAILS CLOSED: only default multi-field / nested pure-term Should-unions; anything with occur!=Should, non-finite/negative boost, phrase/range/glob/set child, or exact-count/zero-limit stays POSTINGS-only.

ACCEPTANCE (per bead): exact external-docid + global-docid + f32 score-bit parity vs exhaustive for k={1,10,100,1000} across default-multi-field/nested, randomized, mixed sealed+Delta, tombstone, offset fixtures; setup-inclusive paired 100k/1M release A/B must beat BOTH the E4.4 nested comparator and the same-binary null floor. Ledger keep/reject.

STATUS: premise-confirmed + scoped this turn; implementation is a multi-step rank-safety campaign (deferred group scorer + eligibility + parity fixtures + paired A/B) — starting fresh next turn to avoid incomplete rank-safety WIP. One lever, one commit at land.

comments.author: cc
comments.text:
Design grounded in code (argus.rs MaxScore core) — this is a multi-turn rank-safety + bit-parity campaign, not a quick lever.

KEY DESIGN CONSTRAINT (why deferred GROUPED, not flatten): the acceptance demands f32 SCORE-BIT parity vs exhaustive. A nested union sums (A+B)+(C+D); a flattened flat union sums A+B+C+D in one pass. f32 add is NON-ASSOCIATIVE, so flat produces different score BITS and fails parity. So the group summation structure MUST be preserved: each group (a multi-field term) sums its per-field contributions internally in the SAME order the exhaustive path uses, then the root sums GROUP contributions in group order. Flatten is rejected here for the same reason E4.4 rejected eager-nested — it perturbs the scored topology.

EXISTING CORE (argus.rs): the buffered scored union scores a 4096-doc window by, per active child, score_window[offset] = score_window[offset] + child.score() (near line 3489). competitive_candidates enables MaxScore only when active.len() in 2..=MAX_SCORE_MAX_CLAUSES AND all children are competitive_is_direct_term (nested groups fail this, so no pruning today); MaxScore needs per-child competitive_score_upper_bound + competitive_term_cursor; BMW needs 9+ clauses, total cost >= BMW_MIN_TOTAL_COST (16384), and per-child block_max.

IMPLEMENTATION PLAN (one lever, one commit at land):
1. GroupScorer: a buffered sub-union of a multi-field term's per-field ValidatedTerm cursors. Exposes doc, advance/next, score = internal field-sum in exhaustive order (bit-preserving), competitive_score_upper_bound = sum of field whole-term ceilings, cost = sum of field posting costs. DEFERS opening its inner field cursors until first made competitive (lazy open behind a cell).
2. Relax competitive gate: add competitive_is_groupable (a GroupScorer with a finite ceiling) alongside competitive_is_direct_term; grouped MaxScore participates when all active children are direct-term-or-group. Keep BMW direct-term-only for now (grouped BMW is a follow-up).
3. Eligibility FAILS CLOSED: only default multi-field / nested pure-term Should-unions (occur==Should, finite non-negative boost, no phrase/range/glob/set child); exact-count and zero-limit stay POSTINGS-only and never populate the bound cache.
4. Wire prunable_scorer_shape to admit Union direct_terms:false whose children are all groupable, as a new PrunableScorerShape::GroupedUnion.
5. Parity harness: exhaustive vs grouped, exact external-docid + global-docid + f32-bit for k in {1,10,100,1000} across default-multi-field/nested, randomized, mixed sealed+Delta, tombstone, offset. Then setup-inclusive paired 100k/1M release A/B vs the E4.4 nested comparator + same-binary null floor.

STATUS: turn 2 — premise confirmed (turn 1: nested multi-field unions lower to Union direct_terms:false, fail the gate, score exhaustively), flatten ruled out on bit-parity (this turn), existing MaxScore core mapped, plan concretized. Turn 3+: implement GroupScorer + gate + parity harness, then A/B. No partial rank-safety WIP will be committed.

comments.author: cc
comments.text:
Sibling check + implementation-ready (turn 2 close). Compared e8.5.2 (demand-gated BLOCKMAX): the MaxScore whole-term ceiling is derived FROM BLOCKMAX (quiver.rs into_pruning_metadata -> BlockMaxList::parse; argus.rs:309 ceiling = conservative max over remaining block-max entries), so 2-8 term MaxScore queries CANNOT simply skip the BLOCKMAX open — e8.5.2 only helps 9+ term below-cost-threshold roots (narrow) and would need a compact per-term whole-term-max added to the segment format to decouple. e8.5.1 stays the higher-EV, broader lever (common multi-field default queries, currently fully unpruned).

Architecture fully mapped and implementation-ready: BufferedUnionScorer.active already holds nested-union children and the full-window path already scores them (score_window[offset] += child.score(), argus.rs ~3489); the only gap is group-level pruning. competitive_candidates gates MaxScore on all-children-competitive_is_direct_term and generates candidates over TERM cursors. Implementation = GroupScorer (lazy-open per-field sub-union; doc/advance/score bit-order-preserved/upper_bound=sum-of-field-ceilings/cost) + competitive_is_groupable gate + group candidate generation, then exhaustive-vs-grouped parity + paired A/B. Next: one focused implementation push, verify locally, land only when parity holds.

comments.author: cc
comments.text:
Layer 2 spec (candidate generation) — derived from reading max_score_candidates (argus.rs ~3619). Layer 1 (group_upper_bound + Union arm) LANDED eab66078. Layer 2 is a single focused rank-safety change; implement directly from this:

max_score_candidates (existing, terms) does: (1) sort cursor indices by term_upper_bound asc; (2) grow `nonessential` while conservative_bound_sum(prefix) < cutoff; (3) if nonessential==0 return None; (4) candidates = union of ESSENTIAL cursors' docs in [window_start,horizon_end) via cursor.doc()/next() on the SEPARATE competitive_term_cursor (does NOT disturb main state); (5) sort+dedup -> CompetitiveCandidates{MaxScore,docs,blocks_skipped:0}. fill_candidate_window then scores only those docs.

grouped_max_score_candidates (new, mirror): identical shape but
- partition key = group_upper_bound() (layer 1) instead of term_upper_bound(); reuse conservative_bound_sum on the group ceilings.
- essential-group doc enumeration = group_competitive_docs(group, horizon_end): for a ScorerNode::Union group, for each active TERM child call child.competitive_term_cursor() (separate cursor) and enumerate doc()/next() until >= horizon_end, pushing into the shared candidate Vec; the union of a group's terms' docs = the group's docs. Fail closed (return None) if any child lacks a competitive_term_cursor.
- sort+dedup, return CompetitiveCandidates{MaxScore,...}.

Wiring in competitive_candidates: add a branch BEFORE the `2..=MAX_SCORE_MAX_CLAUSES => return Ok(None)` fallback: `2..=MAX_SCORE_MAX_CLAUSES if self.active.iter().all(ReferenceScorer::competitive_is_groupable) => grouped`, then call grouped_max_score_candidates. Add competitive_is_groupable = matches!(node, Union(u) if u.group_upper_bound().is_some()). NOTE this is behavior-neutral until the gate opens BLOCKMAX for group terms (their term_upper_bound is BLOCKMAX-derived), because without bounds group_upper_bound is None -> is_groupable false -> branch skipped -> exhaustive.

Gate (prunable_scorer_shape / query_has_prunable_root_union): admit Union{direct_terms:false} whose children are all pure-term groups as a new PrunableScorerShape::GroupedUnion; make query_has_prunable_root_union true for it so rank_pruning=true propagates -> group terms open BLOCKMAX -> bounds exist -> the grouped branch activates. Fail closed for occur!=Should, non-finite/negative boost, phrase/range/glob/set child, exact-count, zero-limit.

RANK-SAFETY watchpoints: (a) group_upper_bound f32 sum must stay >= realized group score — reuse conservative_bound_sum (it already guarantees a conservative ceiling; layer 1 used a plain += which the parity harness must confirm or switch to conservative_bound_sum). (b) f32 SCORE-BIT parity: fill_candidate_window scores candidates via the same full-window per-child sum, so retained docs are bit-identical; skipped docs are provably below cutoff. Parity harness: exhaustive (no cutoff) vs grouped, exact extern-docid+global-docid+f32-bit for k in {1,10,100,1000} across default-multi-field/nested/randomized/mixed sealed+Delta/tombstone/offset. Then setup-inclusive paired 100k/1M A/B vs E4.4 nested comparator + null floor. Land only when parity holds.

CORRECTION to layer 1 to check first: group_upper_bound uses plain `total += bound`; switch to conservative_bound_sum (already in argus, used by max_score_candidates) so the ceiling is provably conservative before wiring the consumer.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
cc/SageCardinal (perf-campaign-20260725, cc/STRUCTURAL). ACTIVATED the gate — the step missing after 229348dd landed the machinery dormant.

WHAT CHANGED (index.rs, one lever):
- PrunableScorerShape::Union carries UnionChildKind {DirectTerms|TermGroups|Mixed} instead of a bare direct_terms bool. A root whose children are ALL unions-of-direct-terms (what 'alpha OR beta' lowers to over content+title) is TermGroups.
- query_has_prunable_root_union admits TermGroups at 2..=MAX_SCORE_MAX_CLAUSES only. NOT at BMW_MIN_CLAUSES.. — grouped BMW does not exist (a group has no physical block-max list), so wide grouped roots stay POSTINGS-only rather than paying for metadata nothing reads. Mixed direct-term/group roots refused for the same reason: argus consumes neither branch.
- GROUPED_MAX_SCORE_ENABLED const kill switch; rollback = flip to false, nested unions revert to the exact pre-lever POSTINGS-only path with no other edit.
- bench_search_sealed_forced takes rank_pruning: Option<bool> so ONE binary times pruned vs exhaustive.

RANK-SAFETY VERIFIED IN CODE (not assumed):
1. Only the collector-driven ROOT union gets a cutoff (argus.rs:4336); nested group unions refill via refill()->refill_with_cutoff(None) (argus.rs:3737), so inner groups always fill EXHAUSTIVELY and sum per-field contributions in the exhaustive path's order. f32 add is non-associative — this is precisely what makes score-BIT parity attainable, and why flattening was correctly rejected.
2. fill_candidate_window iterates ALL active children incl. non-essential groups at each candidate doc in scorer-vector order: pruning changes which docs are visited, never how a visited doc is summed.
3. Tie-safety: grouped_max_score_candidates uses the identical strict 'bound < cutoff', so a group whose cumulative bound EQUALS the cutoff stays ESSENTIAL — the conservative direction pinned by maxscore_equal_cutoff_keeps_better_docid_and_negative_weight_falls_back (argus.rs:8557).

Fail-closed worst case: empty/exhausted group -> group_upper_bound()=None -> branch skipped -> exhaustive. Costs a wasted BLOCKMAX open, never a wrong result.

NEW BENCH benches/grouped_maxscore_ab.rs adopts the fleet harness contract: self-reported ELF SHA-256 (part 1; repo-wide compliance is 2.5% per docs/LEDGER_RESURRECTION.md), same-invocation A/A null (part 2), median-CI gate plus a strict 2x-margin variant, cv NEVER a gate (part 3). Bit-parity (global_docid + raw score bits) asserted BEFORE timing at k={1,10,100,1000}, incl. a field-scoped direct2 negative control.

STATUS: gate test green. Full 484-test rank-safety suite + A/B in flight. Nothing lands until parity holds.

title: QG-2 R1 QUARANTINE + portfolio: repair lifecycle equivalence before current-baseline claims
description:
BINDING QUARANTINE 2026-07-30: the opening authoritative-current-baseline language below is superseded. The 0.349775 candidate, 0.345546 rerun, and all earlier QG-2 ratios remain immutable historical diagnostics, not admissible current baselines, because lifecycle scope was asymmetric and replacement-writer/background work was not continuously timed through terminal searchable visibility and complete quiescence. They cannot activate a gate, support a KEEP, authorize flip/release, or headline current performance. Q2C must first freeze the symmetric in-memory contract; Q2R then performs the corrected W=1 fastest-incumbent rerun. The terminal target remains Quill/Tantivy at least 1.5x.


Triggered by the authoritative current-schema QG-2 baseline published at activation commit 73444b59 from timed source 5bb74e76. On the frozen single-worker bulk/medium/1/positions_on cell, candidate Quill measured about 59,818 docs/s versus Tantivy about 171,223 docs/s: paired median 0.349775, CI95 [0.344698, 0.356240]. The independent rerun measured 0.345546, CI95 [0.341425, 0.351114]. Candidate Tantivy/Tantivy A/A was about 1.01454 with CI containing 1.0 and the rerun null was also valid; 15/15 order positions were balanced. This is about a 2.86x gap to parity and 4.29x total improvement needed to reach the terminal 1.5x gate if Tantivy stays fixed. Earlier 0.108 artifacts remain retained historical diagnostics under an older harness state and are not the current baseline.

FAIRNESS ADMISSION: before any production KEEP, resolve benchmark_join_workers_and_rearm. The timed contract currently excludes replacement-writer construction and immediately drops the one-shot rearmed writer. Prove with lifecycle receipts and focused timing that this cannot shift meaningful Quill work out of the measured interval, or change the measured arm to terminal join-without-rearm and rerun candidate plus confirmation. Preserve the current raw bundle either way; never rewrite history.

OPERATION EQUIVALENCE: freeze corpus, settings, executing binary, worker class, order schedule, and correctness oracle. Prove both arms perform equivalent canonicalization/tokenization, indexed fields and positions, document/byte counts, segment and merge policy, term/postings construction, commit visibility, flush/fsync work, crash recovery, and durable publication. Record exact stage/lifecycle receipts, including all 105 join receipts and one-segment before/after state. If semantics differ, repair or relabel the comparator before drawing product conclusions; never optimize away Quill guarantees.

PROFILE: capture stage wall time; CPU cycles/instructions; allocations and bytes; syscall/I/O calls and bytes; fsync latency; page faults/cache behavior; lock/contention; RSS; on-disk bytes; and harness overhead for the real Quill and genuine Tantivy arms. Produce a non-overlapping Amdahl portfolio with measured shares, expected whole-operation impact, confidence, interactions, and prior negative evidence. The portfolio must expose a credible path through parity and toward 1.5x, or prove with measured ceilings why it cannot.

LEVER LOOP: one child bead and commit per counted mechanism. Each child proves behavior, rank, score, error, crash, durability, RSS, and disk parity; measures old Quill versus new Quill causally and the genuine Tantivy incumbent in the same invocation/window with A/A; and ends KEEP or REJECT with a concrete retry predicate. Re-profile after every material keep. Three rejects in one mechanism family force a vein switch. No benchmark-only semantics, reduced work, weakened durability, corpus gaming, hidden setup, cross-commit ratio substitution, or unpublished null controls.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Reference immutable baseline and rerun bundles at timed source 5bb74e76 and activation commit 73444b59, including executable hashes, worker, corpus/config hashes, 30 paired blocks, raw samples, balanced order, CI method, A/A nulls, absolute docs/s, and lifecycle receipts.
2. Resolve the rearm/drop fairness question by proof or a terminal-join rerun; record the disposition without deleting or overwriting the existing baseline.
3. Operation-equivalence covers all timed and untimed stages, fields/positions, documents/bytes, segment/merge state, commit visibility, fsync/durability, crash recovery, and publication. Every intentional asymmetry is labeled and bounded.
4. Exact-cell profiles report per-document and whole-operation stage time, cycles/instructions, allocation count/bytes, syscall/I/O count/bytes, fsync latency, page faults/cache state, contention, RSS, disk bytes, and harness overhead for both engines, or a precise tool limitation.
5. A ranked Amdahl portfolio uses non-overlapping measured shares and distinguishes the about 2.86x parity gap from the about 4.29x gap to the 1.5x terminal target. No arbitrary single-lever or round quota is imposed.
6. One child bead per counted mechanism; every child freezes one production lever, tests, old/new Quill causality, real Tantivy incumbent, A/A, absolute metrics, conformance/durability/memory gates, rollback, verdict, and retry predicate.
7. KEEP requires a credible causal improvement above noise at one source state plus valid incumbent/null evidence and no material correctness, crash, durability, RSS, or disk regression. Otherwise non-destructively restore and ledger REJECT.
8. Refresh profiles and remaining Amdahl budget after each material KEEP; switch veins after three rejects in one family.
9. QG-2 terminal activation remains Quill/Tantivy at least 1.5x on the frozen contract with a provenance-complete bundle. This R1 closes after fairness, equivalence, profiles, portfolio, and executable child graph are complete; it never claims terminal success prematurely.
10. Publish both absolute and relative results. Unavailable metrics or hardware limit claim scope and do not suppress current measurements.

BINDING ADDENDUM: every historical ratio above is append-only quarantined until Q2C and Q2R pass. A current baseline requires equal work_units/byte_count, continuous first-feed-to-terminal-searchable-and-quiescent timing, independent old-Quill/new-Quill/fastest-Tantivy/T-T/Q-Q streams, symmetric in-memory semantics, raw-reconstructable absolutes/intervals/nulls, source/ELF/corpus/PID receipts, and an honest WIN/MISS/NoDecision. Tests reject rearm leakage, background-work gaps, weaker incumbent selection, stream reuse, stale scope, and any attempt to weaken the 1.5x target.

title: QG-6 H3.1: dense IDMAP live-doc witness removes per-posting section and offset revalidation
description: Profile basis: arm-scoped QG-6 R2 at 6220c8cd measured RecoveredSegmentBacking::section at 5.05 percent, RecoveredSegment::is_live at 3.39 percent, and validation at 2.00 percent; these exact keeper and IDMAP-plan paths are byte-identical through origin/main 3843864c. RecoveredSegment::contains_identity_row consumes that decision before touching RecoveredSegmentBacking::section. Preserve the old path byte-for-byte for hole-bearing maps.

Unit-test dense, hole-bearing, empty, boundary, and out-of-range plans; mapped and owned segment search; tombstoned rows; and malformed/corrupt admission behavior. 3. title: QG-1 validity: real Quill/Tantivy indexing + tokenizer denominators across the full fixture matrix
description:
Audit found QG-1 can label a tokenizer self-comparison as Quill/Tantivy and quarantine the whole 34-cell gate, while positions_off currently crashes. Repair the measurement contract before quoting throughput.

- Define versioned operation scopes for tokenizer-only, document analysis, add/index, commit, and searchable publication. Both engines receive byte-identical documents, fields, positions setting, heap budget and thread budget; preprocessing/corpus generation is outside timed scopes or identically included.
- The tokenizer ceiling lane must invoke genuinely distinct Quill and Tantivy analyzer implementations. A shared/self implementation is labeled diagnostic and cannot satisfy the Q/T denominator.
- Materialize the complete declared matrix (scale x threads x positions) from one executable manifest; missing/duplicate cells fail. Run medium decision-value cells first, then full matrix; xlarge may be scheduled but never silently absent.
- Interleave randomized paired blocks with valid A/A null, both-engine absolutes (docs/s, MB/s, stage ms), raw samples, and corpus/ELF/worker provenance. Thread settings must be enforced and logged, with no simultaneous competing benchmark jobs on the worker.
- Verify index output counts, sampled postings/positions and query parity after each measured build so throughput never times corrupt/incomplete work.

Tests: analyzer identity/call counters prevent self-comparison; operation-scope golden tests; positions on/off parity and crash regression; manifest completeness; thread-budget enforcement; deliberately unequal work rejected; raw-summary reconstruction; medium live run repeated on one isolated worker.
acceptance_criteria: Every manifest-required QG-1 cell at smoke and decision scale is present exactly once for both engines, including positions on/off and declared thread counts. Timed scopes and work counters prove byte-identical inputs and comparable analyze/add/commit/searchable work. Analyzer identity proves no self-comparison. Each cell contains docs/s, MB/s, stage absolutes, raw randomized paired blocks, valid A/A, metric-specific interval, thread/heap/profile/corpus/source/executable/worker hashes, output counts and sampled postings/query parity. Invalid or incomplete cells persist as non-claim terminal artifacts; full provisional evidence lands immediately and decision evidence satisfies the predeclared rule.

title: QG-3 validity: measure real update-to-searchable visibility, not batch completion
description:
Audit found QG-3 times a whole update batch but does not prove when each update becomes visible to a reader. Rebuild it around the user-observable contract.

- Define update receipt and visibility fence for each engine. Timed interval begins at accepted update and ends only when a fresh/long-lived reader can query the exact new version; record enqueue, apply, commit/fsync, reopen/refresh and visible timestamps separately.
- Use deterministic mixed inserts/updates/deletes with known document versions and unique probe terms. Verify no early visibility, stale false-positive, lost update, or tombstone resurrection.
- Measure per-document and per-batch p50/p95/p99/max, update/s and durable/searchable distinctions under matched commit policy, heap and reader lifecycle. Do not compare a Quill searchable delta against a Tantivy durable commit without labeling separate scopes.
- Paired randomized blocks, valid A/A, both-engine absolutes/raw samples/provenance and scale ladder are mandatory. Include steady-state warm readers and cold/reopen diagnostic lanes.
- Cancellation/crash fault points prove reported success corresponds to the declared durability tier.

Tests: virtual-clock state-machine unit tests; visibility fence false-positive/timeout; version monotonicity; inserts/updates/deletes; reader refresh semantics; crash/cancellation stages; synthetic timing reconstruction; repeated medium live run with detailed structured stage logs.
acceptance_criteria: Each required mixed insert/update/delete cell proves exact version visibility and durability semantics for both engines, with no early/stale/lost/resurrected documents. Per-document and batch p50/p95/p99/max plus throughput and stage absolutes have sufficient independent samples, paired intervals, valid controls, matched commit/reader policies and full provenance. Searchable versus durable scopes are separate. Crash/cancel tests reject false success. Smoke/intermediate provisional artifacts land before the decision run; every attempt has a terminal status and bounded logs.

title: QG-4 validity: durable steady-state commit latency distribution without rebuild contamination
description:
Audit found QG-4 rebuilds a 100k in-memory corpus and reports only ten samples, which is neither steady-state commit latency nor enough for p99.

- Build the base corpus outside timed windows once per engine, verify parity, then run at least 100 durable commits per cell after warmup; decision-scale p99 requires a sample count chosen before running and reported with interval/quantile uncertainty.
- Each commit applies a matched update batch and includes the same declared durability boundary: writer commit, file/data fsync, directory fsync and reader visibility where the gate contract requires it. Stage timestamps expose which component dominates.
- Isolate base-build, commit, reopen and visibility metrics. Never include corpus reconstruction in a commit sample or amortize different work.
- Use preallocated deterministic update sets, matched bytes/docs/tombstones, randomized engine order, A/A null, absolutes/raw paired blocks and full provenance. Record filesystem/mount/storage/cache state.
- Verify every commit generation is queryable, monotonic and recoverable; injected I/O failure/cancellation cannot be counted successful.

Tests: sample-count/quantile sufficiency; scope instrumentation; durable boundary fault injection; generation monotonicity; recovery; synthetic p50/p95/p99; base-build contamination detector; repeated medium isolated-worker run with structured per-stage logs.
acceptance_criteria: Base construction is outside timed scopes and contamination tests prove it. Every required cell has the predeclared independent commit count sufficient for its quantile uncertainty, matched update bytes/docs/tombstones and durability boundary, per-stage and total p50/p95/p99/max, both-engine absolutes, raw randomized paired blocks, valid control and filesystem/storage/source/executable provenance. Every generation is queryable, monotonic and recoverable; injected I/O/cancel failures never count as success. Provisional evidence lands immediately and decision status follows the fixed rule.

title: QG-6 validity: realistic query distributions, enough tail samples, and per-class absolute latency
description:
TERMINAL QG-6 VALIDITY AND DECISION UMBRELLA. Replace the historical four-query median-of-subsamples path with the frozen raw-tail design owned by children .9.1 through .9.5. The normative matrix is exactly five query classes x k={10,100} x corpus={100000,1000000}=20 cells per required machine class. Each class has exactly 16 unique queries, 80 total. Warm total search latency is normative; cold-open belongs to QG-9 and stage instrumentation is diagnostic outside the timed leaf.

Every cell builds immutable searchable snapshots outside timing and preflights total public-result conformance against four independent arm roles. It then records four macroblock units per query and 64 leaves per arm/unit: 4096 raw leaves per arm/cell. Scheduling is balanced within each query using a four-arm Williams/Latin-square design. Setup, warmup, hashing, logging and stage attribution stay outside timed leaves. The compact schema normalizes provenance while preserving query/unit/block/arm/leaf identities, monotonic timestamps, result digests and raw latency.

Decision orientation is Quill/Tantivy. Estimate ratios of equal-query arm-specific marginal quantiles by resampling query IDs then complete units within query, never individual leaves. Use at least 50000 deterministic bootstrap replicates with endpoint Monte Carlo stability. Across the 20 cells, p50 equivalence uses two one-sided alpha=0.0025 tests, equivalent to a 99.5% interval wholly inside [0.90,1.10]; p99 noninferiority uses a one-sided 99.75% upper bound <=1.0. Quantile-specific Tantivy/Tantivy A/A controls must pass. Every cell and endpoint passes or the gate is not a WIN. Honest MISS/NoDecision artifacts remain durable and trigger measurement repair or the profile-first gauntlet; they never support the default flip.

Required AMD high-core and Apple Silicon class/mode runs use the canonical registry, runner and class-specific A/A bands. No cross-class inference, aggregate masking, smoke extrapolation, self-speedup, or weaker incumbent is admissible. This umbrella cannot close until .9.1, .9.2, .9.3, .9.4, and .9.5 are closed with exact receipts, even though tracker parent-child links are organizational rather than blocking.
design: Five children separate workload identity, measurement, estimation, validation and expensive platform execution. .9.1 freezes the 80-query/20-cell manifest; .9.2 extends the prepared four-arm runner with compact raw leaves; .9.3 owns hierarchical ratio-of-quantiles inference and simultaneous rules; .9.4 integrates one fail-closed validator/ratchet with hostile mutation tests; .9.5 owns resumable x86/Threadripper/Apple execution and assembly. Generic manifest/validator infrastructure remains in .15/.15.1 and is reused, not forked. The gate may terminally measure a MISS, but bd-3beo remains open until a later exact campaign makes every required QG-6 class/cell a WIN.
acceptance_criteria: Children bd-quill-e8-perf-doctrine-x4e4.9.1 through .9.5 close with linked source and remote receipts. The frozen hashed workload contains exactly 80 queries and the executable manifest exactly 20 cells per required class. Every complete cell has four distinct live arms, exact total-result preflight, equal warmups, per-query balanced schedule, 4096 raw leaves per arm, coherent IDs/timestamps/digests, both-engine p50/p99 absolutes and QPS/resource facts, quantile-specific A/A, deterministic query-to-unit bootstrap, stable replicate endpoint, p50 99.5% TOST, p99 99.75% UCB, and exact source/ELF/corpus/query/options/machine provenance. The validator recomputes decisions from raw leaves and hostile fixtures prove false-pass rejection for p99-of-medians, ratio/median confusion, pooled-query masking, leaf pseudoreplication, global-only schedule balance, corrupt IDs/timing/digests, point-only decisions, null-tail failure, 19/20 masking, missing AMD/Apple class, cross-class inference, unscreened incumbent, stale or partial artifacts and summary/raw mismatch. Required Threadripper and Apple modes each have reproducible class-specific sealed runs. All logs are bounded/redacted and attempts persist on failure. Fmt, strict check/clippy, focused/full tests, fault injection, UBS and artifact reloads pass. QG-6 activates only from a complete validator-green artifact; activation may honestly record MISS, but only all-cell WIN can satisfy bd-3beo.

comments.text: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW QG-6 ADDENDUM: build four independent logical indexes (Quill A/B, Tantivy A/B, Tantivy null-left/null-right), give every arm equal warmups and timed calls, and balance/interleave comparison block order. title: QG-6a: frozen 80-query manifest and exact 20-cell decision expansion
description:
Own the immutable QG-6 workload definition before any decision run. Freeze exactly five public query classes matching PerfQueryClass: identifier, short_keyword, natural_language, phrase, and boolean. Each class contains 16 unique normalized query/AST identities for 80 queries total, with declared prevalence/difficulty strata, parser/options contract, expected supported semantics, stable IDs, and content hashes. Expand each class across k={10,100} and corpus={100000,1000000} for exactly 20 normative cells per machine class. Warm total-latency search is normative; cold-open behavior belongs to QG-9, and stage-instrumented samples are diagnostic only. Define the query sampling frame and equal-query weighting; no weighted aggregate or repeated leaf may masquerade as an independent query.

The manifest must support live total-result preflight against Quill and the fastest semantically equivalent Tantivy arm before timing, including ordered IDs, score bits or reviewed divergence, counts, metadata/snippet/public fields, and bounded result digests. Logs use query IDs/classes and hashes, never unrestricted query or document text. Missing, duplicate, reclassified, silently unsupported, one-query, or hash-drifted workloads fail closed before timing.
acceptance_criteria: Manifest validation proves exactly five named classes, exactly 16 unique queries per class, exactly 80 query IDs, and exactly 20 class/k/corpus cells with no hole, duplicate, alias, order-dependent identity, or silent skip. Every query freezes normalized text hash, parsed AST hash, class, prevalence/difficulty stratum, k/options compatibility, expected support/divergence state, and corpus/query-generator revision. Positive fixtures cover common/rare terms, code/path identifiers, phrase positions, conjunction/disjunction/negation, natural prose, no-hit and adversarial syntax within the declared five classes; unsupported syntax is explicit rather than dropped. Two fresh loads and two independent corpus builds reproduce identical manifest/corpus/query hashes and total preflight results. Negative fixtures reject one-query regressions, 15/17-query classes, reclassification, duplicate normalized ASTs, missing k/scale cells, mutated hashes, unknown fields, raw-text logging, cold/stage lanes substituted as normative, and a query whose total public result contract differs without a reviewed register entry. The sampling-frame statement limits claims honestly; if decision intervals are too wide, the remedy is more independent queries, never threshold weakening or leaf pseudoreplication. Focused unit/integration tests, bounded detailed logs, fmt, strict clippy/check, and UBS pass.

title: QG-6b: compact raw-leaf four-arm runner with per-query balanced scheduling
description:
Extend the existing prepared four-arm foundation instead of building a competing harness. For every normative QG-6 cell, persist four independent arm roles: incumbent_null_left, incumbent_null_right, incumbent_competitive, and quill_candidate, each bound to an independently prepared searchable index and immutable engine identity. For each of 16 queries run exactly four complete temporal macroblock units, with exactly 64 individually persisted timed leaves per arm per unit. This yields 256 leaves per query/arm, 4096 leaves per arm/cell, and 16384 total leaf records/cell. Preserve query, macroblock, unit, arm, ordinal, leaf, and sample IDs plus monotonic start/end/duration and result digest.

Use four temporal macroblocks. Every query appears once per macroblock in an independently shuffled query order. Within every query-unit, use a four-arm Williams or Latin-square schedule so every arm occupies every ordinal position equally and predecessor/carryover relationships balance per query, not only globally. Warmups are equal and outside decision samples. Build/populate/commit/configuration, result hashing, logging, stage attribution, and teardown are outside each timed leaf. Normalize provenance once per cell/run so the 327680-leaf machine-class bundle remains bounded without duplicating ELF/source/corpus/query/machine strings in every row. Raw leaves are immutable evidence; summaries cannot replace them.
acceptance_criteria: A complete normative cell contains exactly 16 queries x 4 units x 64 leaves = 4096 leaves for each of four distinct arm identities and exactly 16384 total rows; every row resolves through normalized run/cell provenance to exact source, ELF, engine build, fastest-screened incumbent, corpus, query manifest, options, heap/thread budget, machine class, and run window. Per-query schedule tests prove each arm appears equally in all four positions and has balanced predecessor relationships; a globally balanced but query-local-unbalanced schedule fails. Four independent prepared indexes pass total result preflight before timing and remain immutable through the run. Equal warmup and call counts are attested. Negative fixtures reject shared logical arms, wrong engine identity, setup or digest work inside timing, missing/duplicate/truncated/reassigned IDs, mixed units, incoherent monotonic timestamps, duration mismatch, result-digest drift, unequal warmups, unknown nested fields, stale provenance, partial cells, oversized/repeated provenance, and summary/raw disagreement. A deliberate late slow leaf survives persistence and changes raw p99, proving no per-unit median collapse. The runner emits bounded redacted progress/failure logs with exact IDs and writes durable attempt artifacts on success and failure. Existing prepared-runner behavior, live Tantivy identity, total conformance, fmt, strict check/clippy, focused/full tests, and UBS pass.

title: QG-6c: equal-query raw-quantile bootstrap, simultaneous p50 TOST, and p99 UCB
description:
Implement the normative QG-6 estimator over complete raw-leaf paired blocks. Freeze effect orientation as Quill latency divided by Tantivy latency. For each arm compute the equal-query marginal p50 and raw-leaf p99, then take the ratio of arm-specific quantiles; never use the median or p99 of per-leaf ratios, per-unit medians, or pooled unequal-query observations. Resample query IDs first and complete unit IDs within each selected query, preserving all four arms and all 64 leaves of a selected unit as one block. Leaves are never independently resampled or counted as 4096 independent queries.

For the 20 normative cells, control family alpha 0.05 with per-cell alpha=0.0025. The p50 equivalence decision uses two one-sided tests at alpha 0.0025, equivalent to a two-sided 99.5% interval wholly inside [0.90,1.10]. The p99 noninferiority decision uses a one-sided 99.75% upper confidence bound no greater than 1.0. Both endpoints and every cell must pass, an intersection-union release decision; no additional factor-of-two correction is applied unless the claim changes to simultaneous display coverage for 40 independent intervals. Apply equivalent quantile-specific validity to the same-invocation Tantivy/Tantivy A/A arms. Start with at least 50000 deterministic bootstrap replicates and automatically escalate when Monte Carlo endpoint error could change a verdict.
acceptance_criteria: The estimator consumes only complete QG-6b raw blocks and rejects missing or unequal query/unit/leaf counts. Equal-query marginal quantiles use one frozen empirical definition, nearest-rank ceil(p*N) clamped to 1..N, on 16 equally represented queries; effect orientation and interval direction are serialized. Deterministic hierarchical bootstrap resamples queries, then complete units within query, preserving arm pairing and all leaves, with at least 50000 replicates, fixed seed/provenance, endpoint Monte Carlo error estimate, and automatic escalation until the error cannot cross a decision boundary. Synthetic goldens prove ratio-of-quantiles differs from quantile-of-ratios and median-of-ratios; p99-of-medians can false-pass; one slow query can be hidden by pooled unequal weighting; leaf pseudoreplication creates a false-narrow interval; p50 point-pass can fail 99.5% TOST; p99 point-pass can fail the 99.75% UCB; p50 A/A can pass while p99 A/A fails; and 19/20 passing cells cannot yield a pass. Property tests cover permutation invariance within complete blocks, deterministic replay, monotonic slowdown response, scale units, finite/positive inputs, extreme ties/outliers, and exact threshold boundaries. Output includes both-engine p50/p99 absolutes, ratios, bounds, null endpoints, replicate count, Monte Carlo stability, and decision reasons per cell. Fmt, strict check/clippy, estimator unit/property/golden tests, bounded logs, and UBS pass.

title: QG-6d: fail-closed validator and ratchet mutation suite for raw-tail decisions
description:
Integrate the QG-6 raw-leaf schema and simultaneous quantile estimator into the one executable manifest/validator/ratchet path. The validator recomputes all counts, hashes, marginal quantiles, hierarchical bootstrap intervals, A/A endpoints, p50 TOST and p99 UCB decisions from normalized raw leaves; stored summaries are caches only and any mismatch invalidates the artifact. Promotion requires all 20 normative cells for the exact machine class and source/executable/query/corpus contract, a fastest-screened live Tantivy identity, total result preflight, quantile-specific null validity, and both co-primary endpoints passing every cell. Partial selection remains durable NoClaim evidence and can never mutate itself into a pass.

Version the schema and bind query/unit/block/arm/leaf IDs, monotonic timing fields, result digests, source/ELF/engine/corpus/query/options/machine/run identities, estimator configuration/seed/replicate stability, absolute metrics, and decision reasons. Unknown nested fields, mixed old/new schema, stale hashes, arm substitution, summary-only artifacts, and cross-machine reproduction fail closed with precise bounded diagnostics. Preserve attempt artifacts for every failure and promotion decision.
acceptance_criteria: Golden positive artifacts reproduce validator decisions byte-for-byte from raw leaves for all 20 cells. A hostile mutation matrix rejects: p99-of-medians substituted for raw p99; median/quantile of ratios substituted for ratio of quantiles; unequal query pooling; leaf pseudoreplication; global but not per-query arm balance; missing/duplicate/truncated/reassigned IDs; unequal warmups/calls; shared arms or wrong engine identity; incoherent timestamps/durations; result digest or logging inside the timed region; summary/raw disagreement; insufficient or unstable bootstrap replicates; p50 point-pass/TOST-fail; p99 point-pass/UCB-fail; p50-null-pass/p99-null-fail; 19/20 cell masking; missing required AMD/Apple class; cross-class inference; cache-state/stage diagnostic substituted as normative; unscreened incumbent; unknown nested fields; stale ELF/source/query/corpus hashes; mixed candidate/reproduction provenance; and partial artifacts. Promotion writes immutable rolling and latest artifacts atomically only after verification, then reloads and re-verifies them. Corrupt/tampered/truncated writes leave the prior latest intact. CLI diagnostics identify exact gate/class/cell/query/unit/leaf/reason without raw content or unbounded output. Existing generic validator/ratchet fixtures remain green; schema migration rejects unsupported older QG-6 decision artifacts rather than guessing. Fmt, strict check/clippy, full validator/ratchet tests, fault injection, UBS, and two fresh-process reloads pass.

title: QG-6e: AMD and Apple raw-tail execution, reproduction, and 20-cell assembly
description:
Run and assemble the normative QG-6 raw-tail campaign after the manifest, runner, estimator, validator, total lexical contract, machine registry, host runner, and class-specific A/A prerequisites are green. Execute all 20 cells on every machine class marked required by the canonical registry, including the required high-core AMD Threadripper widths and Apple Silicon modes; continuity x86 runs remain independently scoped. Each class receives its own exact local hardware fingerprint, execution width or observable P/E mode, cpuset/affinity or scheduler facts, SMT/NUMA/governor or thermal/page-size state, load/exclusive lease, durability attestation where applicable, and class-specific null calibration. Missing or invalid required class evidence is never inferred from another platform.

Support resumable disjoint cell shards so useful measurements start immediately. The assembler accepts a shard only when schema, exact source/ELF, fastest screened semantically equivalent Tantivy incumbent, corpus/query/options, machine class, execution mode, run window, total conformance, raw counts, schedule, estimator configuration and null validity match. It rejects overlap, holes, stale provenance, partial cells, and mixed runs. Preserve both-engine p50/p99 absolutes, ratios, simultaneous bounds, QPS/resource facts, raw leaves, failure logs, and terminal WIN/MISS/NoDecision reasons. An honest MISS closes the measurement slice but immediately feeds the active profile-first gauntlet; it never authorizes the default flip.
acceptance_criteria: For each registry-required class and execution mode, at least two independent sealed invocations or validator-proven disjoint shard sets assemble exactly the same 20-cell manifest with 4096 leaves per arm/cell and no overlap or hole. Every bundle passes live total conformance, fastest-incumbent screening, exact four-arm identity, per-query schedule balance, class-specific quantile A/A, raw-leaf p50/p99 recomputation, 99.5% p50 TOST, 99.75% p99 UCB, immutable source/ELF/corpus/query/options/machine provenance, and bounded redacted logs. Threadripper receipts bind canonical trj-zen3-<width>c IDs, effective physical-core width, cpuset, SMT, NPS/NUMA, performance governor, load and exclusive lease; obsolete trj-zen-128c fails. Apple receipts bind chip family, P/E inventory, requested/observable mode and pool width, 16 KiB page size where applicable, thermal start/end, local execution, and symmetric F_FULLFSYNC for durability-adjacent work. Negative assembly tests reject missing class/mode/cell, cross-class or M4-to-M5 inference, mixed host/source/ELF/query hashes, invalid/null-tail drift, stale or duplicate shards, unsupported platform guesses, and a 19/20 aggregate. Every valid loss links its exact artifact to a dedicated active gauntlet lane with a profile and retry predicate. QG-6 activation occurs only from the complete validator-reloaded artifacts; MISS remains an honest measured result and keeps bd-3beo open. Fmt, strict check/clippy, runner/assembler/e2e tests, fault injection, UBS, and artifact upload-on-failure pass.

title: Quill GC: persist per-segment first-unreachable age across continuous valid publications
description: EXACT LIVENESS SUCCESSOR TO THE KEEPER RECOVERY/GC SAFETY FIX. The current conservative global MANIFEST-derived garbage-collection floor advances on every valid publication. A segment that became unreachable earlier can therefore have its grace deadline reset forever by an unrelated continuous publication stream, so it is safe but not eventually reclaimable. Preserve a durable, root-bound first-unreachable observation for each segment or equivalent publication epoch. Later valid publications must neither move that boundary forward nor manufacture an earlier one. The provenance is writer-owned, crash-safe, fsynced before it can authorize deletion, and validated through the admitted generation-root directory descriptor. Missing, ambiguous, substituted, rolled-back, or conflicting provenance fails closed before any unlink. This bead strengthens liveness only; it does not weaken the grace period, the two-slot reachable union, corrupt-current recovery rules, or the active abandoned-manifest witness introduced by bd-z9vcy.
design: Derive first-unreachable state only while holding the cross-process writer admission and comparing the exact pre-publication and post-publication reachable union of MANIFEST plus MANIFEST.prev. Key every record by immutable segment identity and bind it to the admitted generation-root identity, schema, transition generation, and canonical segment content witness. Persist new records with a checksum-protected deterministic format, file fsync, atomic no-replace or expected-old installation, and directory fsync before a sweep can consume them. A later valid publication carries the original first-unreachable boundary forward unchanged. If a segment becomes reachable again, retire its old record only after the reachable publication is durable; a later second unreachability transition begins a new boundary. Duplicate, divergent, future-generation, stale-root, missing-component, pathname-substituted, or partially installed provenance is RecoveryRequired and cannot be repaired by guessing from segment mtime or the newest MANIFEST. Delete obsolete provenance only after the corresponding segment unlink and directory fsync are durable, with idempotent crash recovery at every boundary.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A real writer publishes generations that first make a segment unreachable and then continues publishing unrelated valid generations beyond multiple grace windows. The recorded deadline stays anchored to the first transition and the segment is reclaimed exactly when that original full grace expires; later publications do not reset it. 2. The same outcome survives separate writer admissions, LOCK replacement, process restart, retained old readers, and deterministic clocks; no in-process cache is authority. 3. Crash injection at every create, fsync, install, publication, carry-forward, reappearance, unlink, and provenance-cleanup boundary is idempotent and either preserves the prior authority or fails closed before deletion. 4. Every segment reachable from current or previous MANIFEST remains protected regardless of provenance age, and corrupt or missing slot states retain the existing bd-z9vcy recovery rules. 5. Reappearance before deletion cancels the old unreachable epoch only after durable publication; later disappearance creates a new epoch. Duplicate or conflicting records, generation rollback, content substitution, symlink or special-node replacement, and directory alias swap return typed RecoveryRequired without mutation. 6. After segment deletion is durable, its provenance is removed crash-safely without leaking an unbounded journal; interrupted cleanup is repeatable and cannot resurrect authority or delete a different segment record. 7. Unit, property, mutation-red, separate-process, crash-matrix, descriptor-substitution, long-running continuous-publication, formatting, UBS, strict-remote workspace check, warnings-denied Clippy, and focused keeper tests pass. Explicit non-goal: do not shorten or bypass the configured grace period, weaken the two-slot reachable union, or treat current MANIFEST age as a replacement for per-segment first-unreachable provenance.

title: Direct-term TopDocs exactness across UNION_HORIZON refills and classified ties
description: P0 DIRECT ARGUS CORRECTNESS AND CONFORMANCE RISK. Quill direct frequency-term Should unions traverse fixed 4096-document horizons. Once a bounded TopDocs heap is competitive, an empty competitive candidate window is not exhaustion: later horizons may still contain a winning document. The production loop must continue until every live posting cursor is exhausted, and each refill may refresh the monotone nondecreasing cutoff for efficiency. Reusing an older valid cutoff is exact but may prune less; it is not a correctness failure. This task owns Argus/direct-term execution, conformance-only receipts, exact pinned Tantivy 0.26.1 TopDocs regressions, and the PR oracle invocation that permanently runs them. It does not alter scalar-adapter semantics, live Core V3 routing, count semantics, comparator waivers, codecs, public result contracts, or performance gates. If exact traversal cannot be proven, the public path must return a typed unsupported or error outcome before emitting hits.
design: Use an immutable corpus of more than 4096 documents whose root query is a 3-8 frequency-term Should union. Build two parameterized proof variants. The late-winner variant fills TopDocs before the second refill, produces at least one empty competitive horizon while live postings remain, and places a result-order-sensitive winner after global document 4095 in a later horizon. The tie-order variant creates genuine equal-score cutoff groups at k=1, 20, and 100; every group contains at least two documents split across a refill boundary and, in the two-segment layout, across the segment split. Fetch enough expanded evidence to prove the entire tie group and observe a lower-score sentinel. Run each variant with one explicit segment and with two explicit commits whose tail spans at least two full horizons. Disable Tantivy automatic merging before ingest and bind both engines to their exact ordered searchable segment document counts in an immutable receipt. Make every differential case count_requested=false, assert CountState::NotRequested on both observations, and keep any internal exact-count query isolated to tie-completeness evidence so it can never supply ranked hits, scores, or tie keys. Under conformance-internals only, emit a bounded refill receipt for every k and layout containing layout, limit, segment document count, refill ordinal, window bounds, cutoff score bits, strategy, candidate count, whether the candidate buffer is empty, and whether live work remains. Shipping builds must not expose terms, document identifiers, cutoff values, or per-refill events. Prove temporal order directly: the heap is competitive, a competitive window is empty while work remains, and a later competitive window emits the late candidate. The negative control deliberately implements historical one-shot behavior that terminates after the first empty competitive refill and must disagree with exhaustive and current execution. Also prove that an older legitimate cutoff preserves exact output while pruning no more aggressively than the refreshed cutoff. Tie conformance follows the existing public contract rather than emulating Tantivy internals: single-segment equal-statistics ties must be RankExact. In two segments, Tantivy sorts segments by descending max_doc and ties on DocAddress while Quill ties on global docid; the comparator may classify only the registered TieOrder divergence after complete expansion proves a bit-identical equal-score group. A top-k member substitution is permitted only inside that proven group, while the non-tie rank envelope remains exact. Repeat all proofs from fresh indices and compare stable semantic receipts for determinism; random opaque segment identifiers are never compared.
acceptance_criteria: A. Fixture and topology: the regressions execute a root 3-8 frequency-term union over more than 4096 documents at k=1, 20, and 100. A result-order-sensitive target after global document 4095 is required. Single-segment and two-segment layouts are built by explicit commits; Tantivy auto-merge is disabled before ingest; immutable receipts prove exact ordered searchable segment document counts for both engines, including a two-segment tail spanning at least 8192 documents. B. Count-free native ranking: every differential case sets count_requested=false; Quill and Tantivy expose CountState::NotRequested; Quill ranked and tie-expansion searches execute their native count-free TopDocs paths. Any independent count-only observation is asserted to return no ranked hits and cannot influence rank, score bits, or tie keys. C. Exact late-winner parity: for every k and layout, the strictly scored late-winner variant matches pinned live Tantivy 0.26.1 native TopDocs exactly in hit count, ordered document identity, f32 score bits, and cutoff evidence, with the late target in its expected rank. D. Non-vacuous tie parity: each k has a complete equal-score cutoff group of at least two documents crossing the relevant refill boundary, with enough expanded evidence to prove completeness and a lower-score sentinel. The single-segment equal-statistics variant must be ComparisonStatus::Exact and RankExact, including exact native tie order. The two-segment variant may differ only through the already registered TieOrder class caused by Tantivy DocAddress versus Quill global-docid ordering, and at least one case must exercise that class. Every divergence pointer and any top-k member substitution must remain inside the fully expanded bit-identical tie group. Subject and oracle must expose the same complete tie-group membership and per-document score bits across ranked plus expanded evidence; every non-tie score stratum, document membership, score bit pattern, and relative rank is exact. No comparator waiver or new divergence class is allowed. E. Path proof: conformance-only telemetry exists for every k and layout and proves TopDocs became competitive before the relevant refill, an empty competitive window occurred while live work remained, and a later MaxScore candidate window emitted the late winner. Receipts include refill ordinal, window bounds, cutoff bits, strategy, candidate count, empty or nonempty state, and remaining-work state; no sensitive refill data is compiled into shipping builds. F. Negative and metamorphic proof: a deliberately one-shot collector that stops after the first empty competitive window fails the oracle and misses the late winner, while exhaustive and current execution agree bit-for-bit. A separate test proves any older legitimate monotone cutoff preserves exact results and can only admit the same or more candidates than a refreshed cutoff. G. Determinism and enforcement: two fresh rebuilds per variant and layout produce identical stable semantic comparison and telemetry receipts after excluding opaque random segment identifiers. The test is explicitly selected by the pull-request Tantivy-oracle CI lane, not only nightly. If exact dynamic traversal is unsupported, the public path fails closed with a typed outcome before any hit is emitted. H. Final-SHA validation: focused Argus negatives and metamorphic tests, focused gauntlet tests, the complete live Tantivy-oracle suite, full frankensearch-quill library tests, strict remote workspace check, strict remote workspace Clippy with warnings denied, cargo fmt check, git diff check, and UBS on every changed file all pass. No scalar adapter, comparator waiver, public count, codec, live Core V3, or public result-contract change is allowed.
notes: 2026-07-31 hostile review rejected closure on protected 3f86ea57. Existing e852c01d and a61456ec remain valuable foundations, but their strict-score fixture makes tie coverage vacuous, telemetry covers only k=1, Tantivy segment topology is not explicitly bound, count-free request state is not asserted, and the regression is omitted from the PR oracle filter. The revision corrects three plan defects. First, an older valid cutoff is lower or equal and therefore exact but less selective; historical stop-on-empty behavior is the real correctness negative. Second, quill-language-contract section 5.4 and the Divergence Register define Quill global-docid versus Tantivy DocAddress tie order as an accepted, fully classified TieOrder divergence. Third, an accepted cutoff TieOrder may substitute different top-k members from the same fully expanded bit-identical group, so equality is required over the complete rank envelope rather than the truncated top-k set. Tantivy 0.26.1 segment_updater orders segments by descending max_doc, making the 257 plus 8744 fixture a deterministic non-vacuous witness.

title: Total lexical result-contract observation: metadata, snippets, explain, errors, ordering, and redaction
description: P0 TERMINAL NO-BLIND-SPOT LEXICAL CONTRACT JOIN. The replacement gate must combine ordinary Core Lexical V3, the CASS-profile typed contract, and the native enriched-search/count/page witness. Core V3 observes every value actually returned by LexicalSearch and never fabricates count, snippet, or highlight evidence. The enriched witness separately invokes each native public method. CASS remains an explicit Tantivy compatibility profile. This terminal bead closes only when every consumer-visible lexical modality has method-bound live evidence and the release validator cannot confuse rank-envelope-only or generic campaign success with replacement readiness.
design: Use versioned backend-neutral witnesses at each actual public boundary. Core V3 compares exact order/rank, document ID, raw/normalized score bits, public source/components, metadata and explanation presence/digests, empty shape, stable typed errors, query classification/provenance, and exact deferred hydration transitions. Native enriched evidence compares search_with_snippets results including query_type, metadata, rendered snippet and trusted tag/window behavior, while count and pagination use their own methods independently of top-k length. CASS uses its own exhaustively typed result schema. Canonicalization may normalize only registered laws and never collapse None versus empty, reorder observable arrays, erase cancellation/error distinctions, or attach supplements from another call. Lexical subobjects persist bounded hashes/redacted diagnostics; the current harness is fixture-only because outer campaign query and legacy snippet fields retain plaintext. Private/user-query ingestion requires a separate whole-artifact privacy policy. A dedicated replacement-ready validator joins exact Core V3 verified reload, enriched/count/page evidence, CASS compatibility, feature graph identity, and divergence disposition; generic CampaignReport passed is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a public result field breaks the relevant adapter until handled. Per-field mutation and tamper tests detect every observed ordinary, enriched, count/page, and CASS field. Historical None versus empty metadata is caught through the live shared path. Frozen real Quill/Tantivy campaigns pass registered equivalence laws with explicit nonvacuous successful, empty, deferred-restoration, and typed error/cancellation method witnesses; intentional Quill cancellation correctness is documented and tested without forcing Tantivy non-cancellation parity. Native enriched tests cover metadata None/empty/value, query_type, snippets None/empty/rendered, default/custom tags, UTF-8 windows, truncation, empty/no-match, phrase/boolean, long query, zero limit, typed errors, and unsupported stored schemas. Exact count/page tests prove totals independent of k/offset and never use results.len. V3/V5 replay, legacy fail-closed behavior, unknown versions, omission, mutation, and content-address tamper pass. Fixture-scope redaction canaries pass and no private-artifact safety claim is made. The replacement-ready validator rejects rank-envelope-only coverage, missing enriched/CASS/count/page receipts, or generic passed-only reports. Implementing SHAs and complete exact-final-source strict-RCH suites, fmt, clippy, and UBS evidence are attached.
notes: DEPENDENCY OWNERSHIP: this is the terminal join for ordinary lexical and CASS-profile total contracts. Core-only tests, fuzzers, real-prose lanes and query performance depend directly on bd-live-total-lexical-contract-gxwy. CASS-profile and cross-profile release evidence depend on this bead. This separation permits parallel implementation without weakening the terminal flip gate.
